title: Guide initialized workspaces back to their authored workspace record
summary: When capture cannot find a `@workspace` but the root already has its release descriptor, its refusal now asks the user to restore the authored workspace source from source control and run ia position. A root whose sources have errors still names ia validate; a root without a descriptor still names ia init. Recovery of interrupted host and installation transactions is exposed through ia recover with an explicit --root; directory registry repair still names ia-distribution. Fresh initialization ignore rules and capture preview are described in their separate notes.
